title: gold_eden.agent_memory
description: Eden agent memory store — persistent agent state across turns/sessions. One document per (tenantId, memoryId). Written at AGENT RUNTIME (not by the Silver→Gold ETL); it is agent-operational state, not a Silver projection. Holds episodic / semantic / working / session / user / project memories so Eden agents have continuity, recall, and the ability to learn across interactions. The memory embedding lives in the dedicated vector DB; only the embeddingModel/embeddingVersion/vectorSyncedAt linkage is kept here for semantic recall joins.

tenantId.description: Tenant identifier. First half of the compound key; enforces tenant isolation on every memory read.

memoryId.description: Unique memory identifier (uuid4). Second half of the compound key.

agentId.description: Which Eden agent owns/created this memory.

sessionId.description: Conversation/session this memory belongs to. Null for long-lived (semantic/user/project) memory.

userId.description: End user the memory is about/for, when scope=user.

projectId.description: Project the memory is scoped to, when scope=project.

memoryType.description: Kind of memory. episodic=what happened; semantic=distilled knowledge; working=short-term scratch; session/user/project=scoped context.

content.description: The memory payload — free-form text or a structured object the agent recorded.

summary.description: Short human/agent-readable summary used for fast scanning and as the embed basis.

importance.description: Salience score (0-1) used for retention/eviction and recall ranking.

embeddingModel.description: Model the vector-DB side embeds this memory with. Vector lives in the vector DB, not here.

vectorSyncedAt.description: When this memory's vector was last published to the vector DB; null until stamped.

expiresAt.description: TTL for short-lived (working/session) memory. Null = no expiry. A Mongo TTL index reaps expired rows.
